previous_statement: Apply lem-maincb-stage2-raw-extension to the exact datum produced in node 1.3.1. Its literal output u_2:M_{|U|+1}->A_R is an extended D_2*t_2-isomorphism with the stated near-unit estimate. The uniform u_2 clause of lem-maincb-reset-constant-ledger, for the same producer output and the same W,D_*, records u_2 as an extended D_*t_2-isomorphism with ||u_2(I_{M_{|U|+1}})-u_{A_R}|| <= D_*t_2. By def-extended-delta-inclusion this includes both extended D_*t_2-inclusion typing and bijectivity, exactly the typed-reset input required; no inference from bare bijectivity is made.
new_statement: Use the uniform Stage-2 producer/output clause of lem-maincb-reset-constant-ledger directly, rather than separately instantiating lem-maincb-stage2-raw-extension. For the exact Stage-2 datum and exact prior map produced in node 1.3.1, with t_2:=W.K2*epsilon and epsilon_R:=W.L*epsilon, this clause furnishes its literal output u_2:M_{|U|+1}->A_R as an extended D_*t_2-isomorphism satisfying ||u_2(I_{M_{|U|+1}})-u_{A_R}|| <= D_*t_2. By def-extended-delta-inclusion, the isomorphism conclusion includes both extended D_*t_2-inclusion typing and bijectivity, exactly the typed-reset input required; no inference from bare bijectivity and no unlicensed use of the separate raw-extension theorem is made.
